The 1.6 mm thickness and 1.0 mm hole diameter are assumptions.
The images show extra holes at the top end (power and motor outputs) and the bottom end (VREF, AGC_ON, AWGS and others). Their positions are not given, so they are omitted.
The IC, electrolytic capacitor, trimmer potentiometer, SMD parts, solder pads and the ground pad grid are omitted because their heights and sizes are not stated.
The board corner radius, if any, is not modeled.
The hole list from the analysis used a different axis convention. The holes were remapped so the board length runs along Z and the thickness along Y, as the rules require.
